column1: # Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 13.0.5. Bounded physical iPad play is verified;
# two-controller/haptic qualification and clean performance checks remain.
# Identity/builds measured from the player's base XCI plus cumulative update.
# Preserve the game's composition until both camera and HUD can be corrected.
# Main references save:/save_data/system_data.bin. Require this progress file
# before publishing a whole committed snapshot; verify its live creation at boot.
# The exact-build offline patch gives main a 30 GiB sparse virtual arena, with
# its matching metadata and end bounds. The SDK also needs its ~1 GiB prefix
# and up to 1 GiB placement alignment inside the 32 GiB alias region.
# A physical iPad accepts this 36 GiB host reservation; the original 68 GiB
# reservation fails even with Extended Virtual Addressing. Physical app_pool
# and the 3.5 GiB host heap capacity are unchanged.
